  getting them from you into the composer and handing them to agents as local
  file paths. I'll also need you to pick between the two choices at the end of
  my plan. · summary

←  ☐ Annotate  ☐ Scope  ✔ Submit  →

│ For annotated images: should Wheelhouse have its own markup tool (boxes,
│ arrows, pen, text on an image before you send it), or do you annotate
│ elsewhere (CleanShot, Preview, Markup on iPhone) and just paste the result?

❯ 1. Built-in markup (Recommended)
     A small editor in the composer: box, arrow, pen, text, numbered pins. The
     flattened PNG goes to agents and the original is kept beside it. Adds a lot
     of work on web and in SwiftUI.
  2. Bring your own
     Paste or drop images that are already annotated. Ships much sooner; a
     markup tool can come later.
  3. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  4. Chat about this

Enter to select · Tab/Arrow keys to navigate · Esc to cancel
